findings.source_quote: I have spoken to people who do not confess to be born again, but still hope to go to heaven.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using a more common Urdu ecclesiastical term for 'born again' to match typical theological usage while preserving meaning — e.g. 'روانی طور پر دوبارہ پیدا ہوئے' is too literal; better options include 'قلبِ نو' or 'روحانی طور پر دوبارہ پیدا شدہ'. If preferring 'نوزائیدہ', confirm it is acceptable in the publication's style. No HTML changes needed.
